channel.title: Ordinary Time Weekly Guide Podcast
channel.description: A weekly journey through Ordinary Time (Part 2). Explore themes of growth, discipleship, and faith in action.
channel.author: Eric Kouassi
channel.summary: Weekly reflections, scripture, and prayers for the second half of Ordinary Time.

funding.text: Support the Show by Buying Me a Coffee

episodes.title: Week 1 — The Parable of the Sower
episodes.description: The Parable of the Sower challenges us to be good soil for God's Word. How can you receive His Word this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Mark 4:14 - 'The farmer sows the word.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Mark 4:14 and becoming good soil as we begin Week 1 of 30 in the Ordinary Time journey.

episodes.title: Week 2 — Faith in Action
episodes.description: Our faith should lead to action. How can you put your faith into practice this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: James 2:17 - 'Faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on James 2:17, exploring how living faith manifests through our daily deeds and compassion.

episodes.title: Week 3 — The Vine and the Branches
episodes.description: Jesus calls us to remain in Him. How can you stay connected to Him this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: John 15:5 - 'I am the vine; you are the branches.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 15:5 and the necessity of spiritual abiding to bear fruit in our personal lives.

episodes.title: Week 4 — The Greatest Commandment
episodes.description: Love God with all your heart, soul, and mind. How can you prioritize your love for Him this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 22:37-38 - 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 22:37-38, centering our focus on the primary call of the Christian life.

episodes.title: Week 5 — The Parable of the Talents
episodes.description: God entrusts us with gifts to use for His Kingdom. How can you use your talents this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 25:21 - 'Well done, good and faithful servant!'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 25:21 and the call to faithful stewardship of our unique gifts and skills.

episodes.title: Week 6 — The Bread of Life
episodes.description: Jesus is the Bread of Life, sustaining us. Come to Him this week for spiritual nourishment. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: John 6:35 - 'Whoever comes to me will never go hungry.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on John 6:35, inviting you to find deep spiritual satisfaction in the presence of Christ.

episodes.title: Week 7 — Humility
episodes.description: Jesus modeled humility. How can you practice humility in your interactions this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Philippians 2:3 - 'Value others above yourselves.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Philippians 2:3, exploring the strength found in servant-leadership and putting others first.

episodes.title: Week 8 — The Prodigal Son
episodes.description: God's mercy is boundless. Return to Him with any struggles this week. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Luke 15:20 - 'While he was still a long way off, his father saw him.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 15:20, celebrating the unconditional welcome of our Heavenly Father.

episodes.title: Week 9 — The Good Samaritan
episodes.description: The Good Samaritan shows us how to love our neighbor. Look for opportunities to show compassion this week. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Luke 10:33 - 'He saw him and took pity on him.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 10:33, encouraging us to look past boundaries to serve those in need.

episodes.title: Week 10 — Gratitude
episodes.description: Gratitude transforms our perspective. What are you thankful for this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 - 'Give thanks in all circumstances.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on 1 Thessalonians 5:18 and the power of a grateful heart in our spiritual walk.

episodes.title: Week 11 — The Light of the World
episodes.description: Jesus calls us to be His light in the world. How can you shine for Him this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 5:14 - 'You are the light of the world.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 5:14, focusing on our identity as witnesses to Christ’s love in our communities.

episodes.title: Week 12 — Perseverance
episodes.description: Perseverance in faith leads to a harvest. Keep doing good, even when it's hard. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Galatians 6:9 - 'Let us not become weary in doing good.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Galatians 6:9, offering encouragement to stay the course in your spiritual journey.

episodes.title: Week 13 — The Lost Sheep
episodes.description: Jesus seeks the lost with love. How can you reach out to someone who feels lost this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Luke 15:4 - 'Go after the lost sheep until he finds it.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 15:4 and our call to reflect the Shepherd's heart for the marginalized.

episodes.title: Week 14 — Stewardship
episodes.description: We are stewards of God's gifts. How can you use your time, talents, or resources for Him this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: 1 Peter 4:10 - 'Use whatever gift you have received to serve others.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on 1 Peter 4:10 and the responsibility of using our resources for the common good.

episodes.title: Week 15 — The Cost of Discipleship
episodes.description: Following Jesus requires sacrifice. What is He calling you to surrender this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Luke 14:27 - 'Carry their cross and follow me.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Luke 14:27, examining the radical commitment required to follow Christ fully.

episodes.title: Week 16 — The Power of Prayer
episodes.description: Prayer connects us to God's peace. Bring your concerns to Him this week. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Philippians 4:6 - 'Present your requests to God.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Philippians 4:6, inviting you to trade anxiety for the peace that comes through consistent prayer.

episodes.title: Week 17 — The Parable of the Workers
episodes.description: God's grace is generous and often surprising. Trust in His fairness and love for all. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 20:16 - 'The last will be first, and the first will be last.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 20:16 and the radical, non-merit-based nature of God's kingdom and grace.

episodes.title: Week 18 — Community
episodes.description: We grow in faith through community. How can you connect with other believers this week? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Hebrews 10:24-25 - 'Spur one another on toward love and good deeds.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Hebrews 10:24-25, highlighting the importance of fellowship for spiritual encouragement.

episodes.title: Week 19 — The Rich Young Man
episodes.description: Jesus challenges us to let go of attachments. What might He be asking you to release? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Mark 10:21 - 'Go, sell everything you have... Then come, follow me.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Mark 10:21, asking us what 'one thing' might be standing between us and total discipleship.

episodes.title: Week 20 — The Widow's Offering
episodes.description: God values the heart behind our giving. Give generously, even in small ways, this week. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Mark 12:43-44 - 'This poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Mark 12:43-44, honoring the quiet sacrifice that is seen and loved by God.

episodes.title: Week 21 — The Ten Commandments
episodes.description: The Ten Commandments guide us in loving God and others. Reflect on how you can live them out. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Exodus 20:3 - 'You shall have no other gods before me.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Exodus 20:3 and the foundational principles that lead to a flourishing life with God.

episodes.title: Week 22 — The Parable of the Net
episodes.description: The Kingdom of Heaven gathers all people. Pray for those who don't yet know Christ. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 13:47 - 'The kingdom of heaven is like a net.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 13:47, contemplating the universal reach of God's invitation and the finality of His kingdom.

episodes.title: Week 23 — Hope in Christ
episodes.description: Christ is our hope. Let His hope fill you as Ordinary Time continues. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Romans 15:13 - 'May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Romans 15:13, anchoring our souls in the joyful certainty of God's promises.

episodes.title: Week 24 — The Second Coming
episodes.description: As Ordinary Time nears its end, we look forward to Christ's return. Are you ready for His coming? Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 24:44 - 'The Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 24:44, turning our hearts toward the future hope of Christ's return in glory.

episodes.title: Week 25 — Christ the King
episodes.description: The last Sunday of Ordinary Time celebrates Christ the King. Proclaim Him as King of your life. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Revelation 19:16 - 'King of kings and Lord of lords.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Revelation 19:16, concluding the main liturgical season by honoring Christ's supreme authority.

episodes.title: Week 26 — Living in Expectation
episodes.description: As Ordinary Time extends, live in expectation of Christ's return, staying vigilant in faith. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: 1 Thessalonians 5:2 - 'The day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on 1 Thessalonians 5:2, encouraging a lifestyle of spiritual readiness and awareness.

episodes.title: Week 27 — Faithful Endurance
episodes.description: Run the race of faith with endurance as Ordinary Time continues, trusting God's strength. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Hebrews 12:1 - 'Run with perseverance the race marked out for us.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Hebrews 12:1, finding inspiration from the 'cloud of witnesses' to persist in our faith.

episodes.title: Week 28 — God’s Abundant Grace
episodes.description: God’s grace is sufficient for every moment. Trust in His provision as you serve Him. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: 2 Corinthians 9:8 - 'God is able to bless you abundantly.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on 2 Corinthians 9:8, resting in the abundance of God's capacity to equip us for every good work.

episodes.title: Week 29 — Seeking God’s Kingdom
episodes.description: Prioritize God’s Kingdom in all you do, trusting Him to provide for your needs. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Matthew 6:33 - 'Seek first his kingdom and his righteousness.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Matthew 6:33, realigning our daily priorities with the eternal values of God's kingdom.

episodes.title: Week 30 — Preparing for Advent
episodes.description: As Ordinary Time draws to a close, prepare your heart for the coming of Advent and Christ’s return. Follow along weekly: https://ordinarytime.dailyaudio.cf
episodes.author: Eric Kouassi
episodes.subtitle: Romans 13:11 - 'The hour has already come for you to wake up.'
episodes.summary: A reflection on Romans 13:11, preparing our spirits for the transition into the season of expectant waiting.
